She heads a crew of her own and is very protective of them, treating them like family. She is in debt to an Alchemist for stealing and selling his Philosophers Stone.

Finally, is a character loosely inspired by Han Solo. A Kitsune Gunslinger smuggler named Kara Kōkatsu. Hailing from a culturally Japanese area of a culturally Jamaican island chain, this Kitsune tends to take things easy. Oh, and the Cannabis helps with that. Occasionally, though, Kara will grow a conscience, which can lead her to dump cargo. This leads in to her debt, which, in true inspiration from Han Solo, is a Jabba the Hutt style mob boss complete with large fur coat (don't worry, he won't magically morph into a slug in the 3rd movie).
